state.qs_crash: test_motion's probe (qs -p motion_probe.qml) segfaulted twice in 60 bare runs today, both toasted on the founder's desktop. Quickshell relaunches itself after a crash and the probe reruns, so the test passed and hid the crash. Under gdb (a caught SIGSEGV never reaches systemd-coredump, so no toast) 69 runs crashed 0 times, so no backtrace. The crashes appeared only with J15's patched probe (2 of 90 runs) and not before (0 of about 125); J15's patch adds a 150 ms busy-wait on the UI thread (while (Date.now() < end) {}), which J15 cannot exclude as the trigger. Other probes (media_probe, recent_probe) crashed on 10-07, so the family predates it. ulimit -c 0 was not tested; it may still journal the crash and toast.
